items.title: Masterclass internazionale di canto lirico — Simone Piazzola & Alberto Bellio
items.teacher: M° Simone Piazzola (baritone); M° Alberto Bellio (pianist)
items.instrument_or_voice: Canto lirico · tecnica vocale, dizione, fraseggio, intonazione, interpretazione e approccio scenico
items.location: Teatro Torresino, Via Torresino 2, 35122 Padova (PD), Italia
items.description_zh: 面向歌剧演唱者的四日国际声乐大师班，由男中音 Simone Piazzola 与钢琴家 Alberto Bellio 指导，内容包括声乐技术、意大利语咬字、乐句、音准、音乐诠释与舞台表达。正式学员需提交至少两首准备演唱的曲目，并将填写签名的报名表发送至 lyric@veniceoperaarts.com；旁听学员也可报名。官方报名规则把截止日期写为“2026年11月31日 00:30”，但11月没有31日；同一文件另说明满15名报名者即提前关闭报名。因此平台不填写未经确认的截止日期，建议申请前直接向主办方确认剩余名额和正确截止时间。

evidence.excerpt: Official organizer page: 2–5 December 2026, Padova | Teatro Torresino; final concert on 5 December at 20:15; Simone Piazzola (baritone) and Alberto Bellio (pianist); the programme is for opera singers and includes vocal technique, diction, phrasing, intonation, interpretation and stage approach.

Official rules PDF: singers submit at least two repertoire titles and a signed registration form by email; active participants €450, auditors €80. The printed deadline is “31 Novembre 2026 at 00:30” (an invalid calendar date); the same rules state registration closes once 15 enrolments are reached.
Official registration form confirms the Padova masterclass dates 2–5 December 2026, venue Teatro Torresino, and the active-singer/auditor registration categories.
